items.title: Bernstein Sees PepsiCo Falling to $128. Its North America Business Is the Reason
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBernstein downgraded PepsiCo to Underperform and cut its target to $128, citing weak North American demand that it expects to keep costing volume and share. North American beverage volume fell 2% in the third quarter, while international revenue grew 9.

items.title: How KFC Partnership Loss Will Impact PepsiCo (PEP) Investors
items.summary: PepsiCo is cutting about 1,000 jobs in its North American units after pressure from activist investor Elliott, while at the same time reaffirming a higher quarterly dividend of $1.48 per share, up 4% year on year and payable on 6 January 2027 to holders as of 4 December 2026. The loss of KFC's nearly 40 year exclusive U.S. fountain business to Coca-Cola, alongside analyst concerns about soft North American volumes and higher costs, puts more attention on PepsiCo's productivity plan as well...
